newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold, silver shed early gains, end lower.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold, silver shed early gains, end lower.

text.p: Gold and silver opened higher on Wednesday on a firm world trend but improved supplies trimmed the early gains towards close, dealers said.
"Customs' sale of confiscated gold and silver had improved the supplies in the market," said a dealer. On Tuesday gold was down by five rupees per 10 grammes while silver was steady.
The customs' sale had also eased the shortage of ready stock and sentiment at close remained subdued, the dealer added.
Gold biscuits (116.50 grammes each) opened 100 rupees higher at 58,600 rupees but closed lower at 58,500 rupees.
